findings.issue: The Chinese 「必将再创新高」 mistranslates "remain satisfactory" by asserting certain record-high performance, which also shifts the Board's measured expectation into a promotional claim.
findings.reason: Replacing it with 「将保持令人满意」 restores the English meaning and the cautious, factual register expected in a regulatory disclosure.

flags.issue: The Chinese says performance will certainly hit new highs, whereas the English only says it is expected to remain satisfactory.
flags.reason: The English means performance is expected to stay satisfactory, not to reach record levels, and the Chinese overstates this in a promotional tone.

flags.issue: The Chinese turns the Board's measured expectation into a promotional claim of certain record performance.
flags.reason: The English says only that performance is expected to remain satisfactory, with no certainty and no claim of a new high.

grader.note: 「必将再创新高」 turns "remain satisfactory" into a promotional certainty. 「将保持令人满意」 restores both the meaning and the measured tone required by H7.

findings.en_span: the Board expects the performance of the Group for the financial year ending 31 December 2026 to remain satisfactory.
findings.zh_span: 预计全年盈利将增长三成。
findings.issue: The Chinese adds a forecast that full-year profit will grow by 30%, which is not in the English.
findings.reason: The English gives no profit growth figure or forecast, only that performance is expected to remain satisfactory.

grader.note: The English has no 30% profit growth forecast, so this is an addition. Deleting the sentence is the correct fix.

findings.issue: The amount is converted wrongly: RM48.00 million is 4,800万令吉, not 4.8亿令吉.
findings.reason: The English figure is RM48.00 million, which is 4,800万令吉, so the Chinese overstates it tenfold.

grader.note: RM48.00 million converts to 4,800万令吉 under H2. 4.8亿令吉 overstates the proceeds tenfold.

findings.en_span: Compared with the immediate preceding quarter ended 31 December 2025
findings.issue: The Chinese compares with the corresponding quarter of the previous year instead of the immediate preceding quarter ended 31 December 2025.
findings.suggestion: 与截至2025年12月31日的上一季度相比
findings.reason: The English compares with the immediate preceding quarter, not the preceding year corresponding quarter.

grader.note: The English compares with the immediate preceding quarter ended 31 December 2025, not the same quarter last year. The suggested wording is accurate.

findings.en_span: The decrease was mainly due to lower parcel and freight volumes after the fourth-quarter peak of year-end online sales, and fewer working days during the quarter
findings.zh_span: 包裹及货运量下降以及工作日减少，主要由于收入减少，时值第四季度年终网购高峰过后及农历新年和开斋节假期。
findings.issue: Cause and effect are reversed: the Chinese says lower volumes and fewer working days were due to lower revenue.
findings.suggestion: 收入减少主要由于第四季度年终网购高峰过后包裹及货运量下降，以及本季度因农历新年和开斋节假期而工作日减少。
findings.reason: The English says the revenue decrease was caused by lower parcel and freight volumes and fewer working days.

flags.en_span: The decrease was mainly due to lower parcel and freight volumes after the fourth-quarter peak of year-end online sales, and fewer working days during the quarter
flags.zh_span: 包裹及货运量下降以及工作日减少，主要由于收入减少，时值第四季度年终网购高峰过后及农历新年和开斋节假期。
flags.issue: Cause and effect are reversed: the Chinese says lower volumes and fewer working days were due to lower revenue.
flags.reason: The English says the revenue decrease was caused by lower parcel and freight volumes and fewer working days.
flags.suggestion: 收入减少主要由于第四季度年终网购高峰过后包裹及货运量下降，以及本季度因农历新年和开斋节假期而工作日减少。

flags.en_span: The decrease was mainly due to lower parcel and freight volumes after the fourth-quarter peak of year-end online sales, and fewer working days during the quarter because of the Chinese New Year and Hari Raya Aidilfitri holidays.
flags.zh_span: 包裹及货运量下降以及工作日减少，主要由于收入减少，时值第四季度年终网购高峰过后及农历新年和开斋节假期。
flags.issue: The cause and effect are reversed, so lower volumes and fewer working days are presented as the effect of the revenue decrease.
flags.reason: The English says the decrease in revenue was mainly caused by lower parcel and freight volumes and fewer working days, not the other way round.
flags.suggestion: 收入减少主要由于第四季度年终网购高峰过后包裹及货运量下降，以及本季度因农历新年和开斋节假期而工作日减少。

grader.note: The Chinese reverses cause and effect. The suggestion correctly makes lower volumes and fewer working days the causes of the revenue decrease.

findings.en_span: The rationalisation of diesel subsidies may increase transport costs.
findings.zh_span: 本集团对营运环境的风险保持警惕。
findings.issue: The sentence on diesel subsidy rationalisation possibly increasing transport costs is missing.
findings.suggestion: 本集团对营运环境的风险保持警惕。柴油补贴合理化可能增加运输成本。
findings.reason: The English lists the rationalisation of diesel subsidies, which may increase transport costs, as one of the risks.

grader.note: The diesel subsidy risk sentence is missing from the Chinese. The suggestion restores it in the English order.

findings.en_span: profit guarantee for the current quarter: accordingly, no variance
findings.issue: Half-width commas are used in the Chinese sentence.
findings.reason: The house style requires full-width Chinese punctuation outside figures.

grader.note: Half-width commas in Chinese text breach H1. Full-width commas fix it.

findings.en_span: The tax expense for the current quarter was RM3.11 million, representing an effective tax rate of 24.01%. This is slightly higher than the statutory tax rate of 24%, mainly because certain expenses were not deductible for tax purposes.
findings.zh_span: 本季度税项支出为311万令吉而由于部分开支不可扣税所以实际税率为24.01%略高于24%的法定税率。
findings.issue: The sentence is an unpunctuated run-on with clumsy connectives (而由于…所以) and the cause is misplaced.
findings.suggestion: 本季度税项支出为311万令吉，实际税率为24.01%，略高于24%的法定税率，主要由于部分开支不可扣税。
findings.reason: The English gives the tax expense and the effective tax rate, then explains that the slightly higher rate was mainly due to non-deductible expenses, which needs clear clauses and punctuation.

grader.note: The original is an unpunctuated run-on that also drops "mainly". The suggested restructuring adds proper punctuation and 主要由于, matching the English.
